<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def probe(row,col,label):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}], intent='explore')
    a=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    diff=[(r,c,a[r][c],b[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]!=b[r][c]]
    non_timer=[d for d in diff if d[0]!=1]
    print(label, "step", current_frame.step, "diff", len(diff), "non-timer:", non_timer[:12])

probe(35,31,"bottom yellow")
probe(42,20,"icon1 black")
probe(45,37,"muzzle")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
